• Episode 1006 | 24 June 2025
This episode of Tarikh draws a haunting parallel between the past and the present in the Middle East. Israel warns that Iran’s Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Khamenei, could meet a similar end as Saddam!
The episode rewinds to 1979, the year two men rose to power with clashing ideologies: Saddam in Baghdad, Khomeini in Tehran.
Saddam’s reign ended in 2003.Khamenei, however, tightened his grip expanding Iran’s reach through the IRGC and regional proxies like Hezbollah and the Houthis.
